claim_boundary: The bound has finite-sample split-conformal cellwise coverage for the exact native workload, node, observed hardware-normalized multi-window external-load regime, allocation, co-location count, total work, and cache-state cell. The regime is sampled before the controlled group starts; run-window external load remains an audited outcome. Rows from other observed states are excluded before fitting and calibration. The conformal base model uses training groups only, and its calibration residuals remain frozen. The operational point ETA separately uses all pre-holdout training and calibration groups; it has no conformal coverage claim and cannot alter the lower-service bound. Every group member has a task-native phase-aware natural-completion model. This is not joint coverage over arbitrary load states.
